name: dmengine-fumo-resume-noetag
description: Mode C FUMO resume without an ETag: the mock advertises Accept-Ranges but omits the ETag on the first 64/184 object response. The engine records offset 64, logs eTag=<[null]> and isIgnoreMissingETag=0, then falls back to a full 184-byte GET instead of a Range request. The full download completes (DL session complete, state 40) and the install notification is posted. No install or update-success claim is made.
